issues.description: The problem statement uses two different method identifiers for the same concept: the UML and many parts refer to an abstract method messageOnFeed(), while other parts of the description (e.g., feedAllAnimals() and the animal-specific return-value instructions) refer to getFeedingSound(). The solution and intended code use messageOnFeed(). This naming mismatch in the problem text can confuse students about which method to implement and which method Farm.feedAllAnimals() / singFarmSong() should call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across the problem statement, template, and solution. Preferably update all references to use messageOnFeed() (to match the UML and the solution), and change the textual instructions that mention getFeedingSound() to messageOnFeed(). Alternatively, change the UML/spec to use getFeedingSound() everywhere and update the solution/template accordingly.
